title: W-35: enforce a minimum backup passphrase and warn on a weak one
description: Source: the consolidated pre-public security review (opum-doc, 2026-10-30), reviewed at b1dae53374a8c0c3514f015ff77faac9af643e2d; tracked under ODOC-552 and parent WCLI-95. Report id: W-35, ruling A. Ruling A: enforce a minimum and warn on a weak one. Today only an empty passphrase is refused (src/adapters/passphrase.ts, src/application/backup.ts), so a one-character passphrase protects every secret in every project at roughly 0.1 s per offline guess. The exact minimum or entropy estimate is a design detail to confirm with opum-doc before the build.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A passphrase below the minimum is refused with a safe error and a weak one draws a warning
The minimum and the warning wording are recorded, with tests in both directions
The backup command's documentation states that strength is the passphrase's
